documentFindings.finding: Font family and fallback not fully defined: exact proprietary font family is UNKNOWN.
Font-source strategy missing: no specification for loading Korean webfont with font-display: swap.
Size in px and rem not defined: DESIGN_INDEX provides px values but no rem equivalents for any role.
Weight not fully specified: DESIGN_INDEX provides numeric weights (e.g., 600, 500, 700, 400) but does not map them to CSS weight names or verify availability in font stack.
Line height in px and unitless form not fully specified: DESIGN_INDEX provides values like '20 px' or '1.18' but does not explicitly label which is px and which is unitless for all roles.
Letter spacing provided but not explicitly confirmed as em unit in all cases: values like '-0.01em' are present, but no evidence that unit is consistently em across all roles.
Casing not specified for any role: DESIGN_INDEX contains no information about text transformation (e.g., uppercase, lowercase, capitalize).
Decoration not specified for any role: DESIGN_INDEX contains no information about text decoration (e.g., underline, strikethrough).
Alignment values present but ambiguous for Section H2: 'Center or section-left' is not a definitive value and lacks evidence-based condition for when each applies.

Maximum width not specified for all roles: missing for Header nav, Locale, Hero body (value present but unit unclear: '470 px' may be max-width but not labeled), Section H2, Section intro, News/crew title, Card meta, Game item, Button label, Recruitment copy, Footer heading, Footer link, Legal/copyright.

Wrapping or truncation not fully specified: values like 'No wrap', 'Preserve 2 lines', 'Natural', 'Clamp 2/3', 'One line', '2–4 lines' are used but not defined in terms of CSS overflow, text-overflow, or line-clamp behavior.

Responsive value at every canonical viewport not fully specified: DESIGN_INDEX provides desktop and mobile values but does not define behavior at intermediate breakpoints or specify canonical viewport widths.
At 200% zoom, content reflows without clipping or loss: stated as INFERRED — HIGH confidence but no evidence or test condition provided to support this claim.
Body copy must remain selectable text: stated as INFERRED — HIGH confidence but no evidence or mechanism specified to ensure selectability (e.g., not using canvas or SVG text).
Do not synthesize bold weights if the chosen font lacks them: stated as INFERRED — HIGH confidence but no evidence or method provided to detect or prevent weight synthesis.
